verses.text: To the People of Ad, was sent their brother Hud a.s. The people of Ad were made successors after people of Nuh and were given tall and strong stature. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 9)
They denied the reminders given by Hud (a.s) to worship one Allah, so Allah saved Hud and his companions and destroyed all the others. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 9)
To the people of Ad, Allah had sent to them, their brother Hud (a.s). (Surah Hud : Section 5)
Hud (a.s) reasoned with his people to worship Allah alone and to use their common sense. (Surah Hud : Section 5)
The people said that they will not desert their gods nor believe in Hud. They further reasoned, that perhaps Hud was afflicted with evil from their gods. (Surah Hud : Section 5)
To this, Hud replied “I am done with your shirk of worshipping other deities. I have put my trust in Allah, Who is my Rabb and your Rabb”. (Surah Hud : Section 5)
Allah’s judgement was passed, and Allah saved Hud and those who believed, through a special grace, and saved them from a horrifying scourge. (Surah Hud : Section 5)

After the people of Nuh, Allah raised a new generation (the people of Ad), and sent them their brother Hud (a.s). Hud (a.s) invited his people to worship one Allah and to fear Him. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 2)

But the people rejected him saying that he was just a human like them and if they obeyed him, they will be lost. They further ridiculed Hud (a.s) on his claim of life after death, saying to the people: “Impossible! Just impossible is that which you are being threatened”. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 3)
The people further said that this man is but an impostor, forging a lie against Allah, and we are not going to believe him. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 3)

Hud (a.s) prayed: “O my Rabb! Help me against their calling me a liar”. So the Blast (of ferocious winds) overtook them and Allah swept them away like rubbish of dead leaves. (Surah AlMu’minun : Section 3)
Mention of the people of Ad and their brother Hud (a.s). (Surah Ash-Shu’ara :Section 7)

Hud (a.s) warned his people to fear Allah and reasoned with them saying: “I do not ask you any reward for my services. Are you erecting a monument on every high place for fun? Are you building strong fortresses as if you are going to live here forever?” (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 7)

Whenever the people laid their hands on anyone, they acted like cruel tyrants. Hud (a.s) kept warning them to fear the torment of Allah Who has given them flocks and children, gardens and fountains. But they disbelieved him and Allah destroyed them completely. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 7)
Surely, in this story is a great lesson, but most of these people do not learn and become believers. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 7)
Reminder of Hud (a.s) warning to his people, the residents of Ahqaf (or sand hills), to worship one Allah and to fear the torment of a mighty Day. (Surah Al-Ahqaf : Section 3)
But the people said: “Bring us the torment that you threaten us with, if you are telling the truth”. (Surah Al-Ahqaf : Section 3)
The torment came in the shape of a cloud and a fierce wind was unleashed on them, and it destroyed everything. (Surah AlAhqaf : Section 3)
